Short title and commencement

ACT XIX OF 1975
ACT XIX OF 1975
PAKISTAN TOBACCO
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 4th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Tobacco Board
(Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.

General amendment of Ordinance I of 1968

ACT XIX OF 1975
ACT XIX OF 1975
PAKISTAN TOBACCO
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 4th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. General amendment of
Ordinance I of 1968.----In the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968 (I of
1968), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordi nance, for the words
"Central Government", wherever occurring, the words "Federal
Government" shall be substituted,

Amendment of section 3, Ordinance I of 1968

ACT XIX OF 1975
ACT XIX OF 1975
PAKISTAN TOBACCO
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 4th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
3. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance I of 1968.----In the said Ordinance, in section 3,-
(1) in subsection (1),--
(a) for clauses (a), (b) and (c)
the following shall be substituted, namely
"(a) one member from the
North-West Frontier Province or the Punjab to be elected by the Cigarette
Manufacturers Association of Pakistan ;
(b) four members, two each from
the North-West Frontier Province and the Punjab, to be nominated by the
Provincial Government concerned from amongst the tobacco growers ;
(c) one member to be nominated by
the Federal Government on the recommendation of the Federation of Pakistan
Chambers of Commerce and industry ;" and
(b) in clause (d), for the word
"five" the word "four" shall be substituted; and
(2) in subsection (2), for the
words "names of all the members of the Board" the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"designations of the
officers of the Federal Government or a Provincial Government nominated to be
members of the Board and the names of the other persons elected or nominated to
be such members."

Amendment of section 4, Ordinance 1 of 1968

ACT XIX OF 1975
ACT XIX OF 1975
PAKISTAN TOBACCO
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 4th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
4. Amendment of section 4,
Ordinance 1 of 1968.----In the said Ordinance, in section 4,-
(1) after subsection (2), the
following new subsection shall be inserted, namely :-
"(2-A) If a member elected
or nominated under clause (a), clause (b) or clause (c) of subsection (1) of
section 3 absents himself from three consecutive meetings of the Board without
the leave of the Chairman thereof, his seat shall become vacant." ; and
(2) in subsection (3), after the
brackets and figure "(2)", the words, brackets, figure and letter
"or subsection (2-A)" shall be inserted.

Amendment of section 12, Ordinance I of 1968

ACT XIX OF 1975

[Gazette of

The following Act of Parliament

published for general information :-
5. Amendment of section 12,
Ordinance I of 1968.-----In the said Ordinance, in section 12, in
subsection (1), for clauses (c) and (d) the following shall be substituted,
namely :-
"(c) one member to be
appointed by the Federal Government from amongst the persons nominated to the
Board under clause (b) of sub section (1) of section 3 ;
(d) one member to be appointed by
the Federal Government from amongst the persons nominated to the Board under
clause (d) of subsection (1) of section 3. ".
